title: 第十三章 孤岛修行无资无援亦登天第十四章 夜出侯府生死一线破七重
lines: 夜色如墨，覆镇北侯府。
西侧偏院，荒草萋萋，夜风穿廊，卷起一地微凉枯叶。
相较于府中核心区域的灯火璀璨、人声不息，这片角落小院永远清冷死寂，像是被整片侯府彻底遗忘的弃地。
沈砚立在院中，青衫静立，抬眼望向深邃夜幕。
漆黑的眸子澄澈冷冽，不见半分波澜，却将整片侯府涌动的暗流尽数洞悉于心。
柳氏的三重毒计，看似绵密阴狠、滴水不漏，想要温水煮蛙、无声绝杀，实则早已被他一眼看透本质。
断资源、孤人心、伏杀机。
三步棋，步步针对武者根本，层层锁死他的前路，不费明面刀兵，不沾半分罪责，妄图让他自生自灭、彻底沉沦。
若是换作寻常少年武者，面对这般全方位的围剿封锁，不出半月，必然修为停滞、道心焦躁、心态崩塌，最终在孤寂与绝望中自我毁灭。
可这套算计，对旁人致命，对如今的沈砚而言，不过是一场绝佳的心境淬炼。
他十年蛰伏，本就无资源滋养、无旁人帮扶，一路走来，皆是孤身独行、绝境求生。
侯府的资源馈赠、人脉帮扶、嫡系优待，他从未拥有过半分，自然也谈不上失去。
柳氏以为掐断了他的修行前路，殊不知，她断掉的只是世俗武者依赖的捷径，却逼不出他半分破绽，更困不住他早已扎根绝境、历经生死的武道道心。
“既然想让我孤岛独居、无人相依。”
沈砚低声自语，语气冰冷淡然，带着极致的从容与笃定，“那我便以孤为伴、以寂为修、以天地为资。”
话音落，他不再多想外界风波，缓步落座于院中青石之上。
月色洒落，清辉覆身，晚风微凉，洗尽一身尘嚣。
沈砚闭目凝神，摒弃所有外界纷扰，心神沉入体内，细细梳理自身修为与肉身状态。
思过崖七日罡风炼骨，让他彻底夯实淬体六重圆满根基，肉身凝练无瑕、气血浑厚澎湃，战力远超同阶，无限逼近淬体七重壁垒。
今日演武场数度出手，越级碾压执事、击溃护卫、重创嫡系，看似酣畅淋漓、毫无损耗，实则肉身经脉、筋骨肌肉都经过了极致的爆发与压榨，潜藏着细微的疲惫与虚耗。
寻常武者大战之后，需丹药滋补、灵气温养、静心调息，方能快速恢复状态、沉淀修为。
可如今柳氏封锁所有修炼资源，府中丹药、灵草、淬体药液、高阶灵气区域，尽数对他封禁，无半分可取可用。
整个侯府，再无一人敢向他递送半点修行物资，甚至无人敢与他多说一言、多看一眼。
从今夜起，他便是侯府之中真正的孤家寡人，身处繁华府邸，却如居无人孤岛。
但沈砚丝毫不惧。
他的修行之道，本就异于常人。
旁人靠丹药增力、靠灵气进阶、靠功法突破，依赖外物滋养，外物断绝，修行便寸步难行。
而他，靠生死淬骨、靠绝境炼心、靠肉身极致打磨、靠道心稳固精进。
外物可断，肉身不灭，道心不朽，修行便永无止境。
沈砚屏息静气，周身肌肉缓缓松弛，筋骨微微舒展，任由夜风穿透衣衫，轻抚皮肉肌理。
他调动体内醇厚气血，缓缓游走四肢百骸、周身经脉，以自身浑厚气血为滋养，以肉身自愈之力修复大战损耗。
没有丹药辅助，便以气血养筋骨；没有灵气温养，便以心神洗经脉。
夜色渐深，月上中天。
整片侯府彻底沉寂，唯有零星灯火点缀夜色，巡逻护卫的脚步声远远传来，沉闷刻板，转瞬即逝。
无人踏足西侧偏院，无人窥探这片荒芜之地，所有人都默契地遵守着三房下达的隐形禁令，对沈砚彻底避而远之、彻底隔绝孤立。
一日、两日、三日。
三日时光，转瞬即逝。
这三日里，侯府彻底变了一番模样。
曾经偶尔会主动攀附、或是中立淡然的旁支子弟，如今见了沈砚，尽数绕道而行、低头避让，眼神躲闪、面色惶恐，不敢有半分停留、不敢有半分对视。
演武堂操练之时，所有子弟自发与沈砚隔开大片距离，偌大演武场，硬生生给他空出一片无人区域，死寂冷清，与周遭热闹喧嚣格格不入。
content_en:
The night is like ink, covering the town of Beihou Mansion.
In the side courtyard on the west side, there are luxuriant grasses, and the night wind passes through the corridor and rolls up the cool withered leaves on the ground.
Compared to the bright lights and constant voices in the core area of ​​the mansion, this small corner courtyard is always cold and dead, like an abandoned place that has been completely forgotten by the entire prince's mansion.
Shen Yan stood in the courtyard, his green shirt standing quietly, looking up into the deep night.
The dark eyes were clear and cold, without any ripples in sight, but they could fully understand the surging undercurrents in the entire Marquis Mansion.
Liu's three-fold poisonous plan seemed to be dense, ruthless, and watertight. He wanted to boil the frog in warm water and kill silently, but in fact, he had already seen through the essence at a glance.
Deprived of resources, lonely hearts, and murderous intentions.
Three moves of chess, targeting the warrior's foundation step by step, blocking his way forward layer by layer, without any use of weapons or any guilt, in an attempt to let him fend for himself and sink completely.
If it were an ordinary young warrior, faced with such an all-round encirclement and blockade, within half a month, his cultivation would be stagnant, his Taoist heart would be anxious, his mentality would collapse, and he would eventually self-destruct in loneliness and despair.
But this plan is fatal to others, but for Shen Yan now, it is just an excellent mental tempering.
He has been dormant for ten years, with no resources to nourish him and no one to help him. Along the way, he has been alone and struggling to survive in desperate situations.
He has never owned even half of the resources, gifts, connections, and preferential treatment from the Marquis Mansion, so naturally he cannot say that he has lost them.
Mrs. Liu thought she had cut off his path to spiritual practice, but little did she know that what she cut off was just a shortcut that secular warriors relied on, but she could not force out any of his weaknesses, let alone trap his martial arts heart that had already taken root in desperate situations and experienced life and death.
"Since you want me to live alone on an island with no one to rely on."
Shen Yan whispered to himself, his tone cold and indifferent, with the utmost calmness and determination, "Then I will use loneliness as my companion, silence as my cultivation, and heaven and earth as my resources."
After he finished speaking, he no longer thought about the external turmoil and slowly sat down on the bluestone in the courtyard.
The moonlight is falling, the clear light covers the body, and the cool evening breeze washes away the hustle and bustle.
Shen Yan closed his eyes and concentrated, abandoning all external disturbances, and his mind sank into his body, carefully sorting out his cultivation and physical state.
Siguoya spent seven days refining his bones in the strong wind, allowing him to completely consolidate the foundation of the sixth level of body quenching perfection. His physical body was condensed and flawless, his qi and blood were thick and surging, his combat power far exceeded that of the same level, and he was infinitely close to the seventh level barrier of body quenching.
Today, there were several attacks in the martial arts arena. They overran the deacons, defeated the guards, and severely damaged the direct lineage. It seemed that they were invigorating and without any loss, but in fact, the meridians, bones and muscles of the physical body had gone through the ultimate explosion and squeeze, and there was a slight amount of fatigue and waste hidden.
After a battle, ordinary warriors need nourishing elixirs, nourishing spiritual energy, and calming down to regulate their breath, in order to quickly recover and settle down their cultivation.
But now the Liu family has blocked all cultivation resources. The elixirs, spiritual herbs, body tempering liquids, and high-level spiritual energy areas in the mansion are all blocked for him, and no one can use them.
No one in the entire Hou Mansion dared to deliver any cultivation materials to him, and no one even dared to say or look at him.
From tonight on, he is truly a loner in the prince's mansion. Living in a prosperous mansion, he feels like he is living on a deserted island.
But Shen Yan was not afraid at all.
His way of cultivation is inherently different from ordinary people.
Others rely on elixirs to increase their strength, rely on spiritual energy to advance, rely on exercises to achieve breakthroughs, and rely on external substances for nourishment. If external substances are cut off, it will be difficult to practice.
And he relies on life and death to temper his bones, rely on desperate situations to refine his heart, rely on the extreme polishing of his body, and rely on the Taoist heart to stabilize and improve.
External objects can be broken, the physical body is immortal, the Tao mind is immortal, and the practice will never end.
Shen Yan held his breath and calmed down, the muscles around his body slowly relaxed, his muscles and bones stretched slightly, and he allowed the night wind to penetrate his clothes and caress his skin and texture.
He mobilized the mellow Qi and blood in his body, slowly traveled through the limbs, bones and meridians all over his body, using his own rich Qi and blood as nourishment, and used the body's self-healing power to repair the damage caused by the war.
Without the aid of elixirs, the Qi and blood are used to nourish the muscles and bones; without the spiritual energy to nourish, the mind is used to cleanse the meridians.
The night is getting darker and the moon is in the sky.
The entire Hou Mansion was completely silent, with only scattered lights dotting the night. The footsteps of patrolling guards came from afar, dull and stereotyped, and fleeting.
No one sets foot in the west side courtyard, no one peeps into this deserted land. Everyone tacitly abides by the invisible ban issued by the third room, completely avoiding Shen Yan and completely isolating him.
One day, two days, three days.
Three days passed in a blink of an eye.
In these three days, the appearance of the Hou Mansion has completely changed.
The disciples from the side branch who once occasionally took the initiative to cling to him or were neutral and indifferent now saw Shen Yan. They all took detours and lowered their heads to avoid him. Their eyes were dodged and their faces were frightened. They did not dare to stay or look at each other.
During the training in the martial arts hall, all the disciples spontaneously separated a large distance from Shen Yan. The huge martial arts field was forced to leave an uninhabited area for him. It was dead and deserted, and was incompatible with the hustle and bustle of the surroundings.
title_en: Chapter 13: Practicing on an isolated island and ascending to heaven with no resources or support Chapter 14: Leaving the Marquis Mansion at night, the line between life and death breaks through the seventh level
